### Table 3. Validation vs test (noisy setting, mean over 3 seeds)

| Method | best val acc (%) | best-val round (per seed) | test acc at best-val round (%) | final test acc (%) | final val acc (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FedAvg | 76.3 | 170, 122, 131 | 68.0 | 64.9 | 73.1 |
| FedProx μ=0.01 | 76.6 | 170, 133, 161 | 67.4 | 64.9 | 74.0 |
| FedProx μ=0.1 | 77.4 | 185, 189, 181 | 70.3 | 66.5 | 75.2 |

Validation = official PathMNIST val split (10,004 images, same source center as train), held by the server and used only for lr/μ/budget selection. Test = official test split (7,180 images, a different source center), partitioned across clients.

### Table 5. Agreement of the final global model with the injected labels on client 0's corruption subset (r200, mean ± sd over 3 seeds)

| Method | run | pred = injected label | pred = original label | excess agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FedAvg | noisy | 0.158 ± 0.019 | 0.572 ± 0.030 | +0.104 ± 0.015 |
| FedAvg | clean (targets not applied) | 0.011 ± 0.001 | 0.906 ± 0.007 | -0.000 ± 0.000 |
| FedProx μ=0.01 | noisy | 0.142 ± 0.011 | 0.584 ± 0.018 | +0.090 ± 0.009 |
| FedProx μ=0.01 | clean (targets not applied) | 0.012 ± 0.003 | 0.902 ± 0.017 | -0.000 ± 0.001 |
| FedProx μ=0.1 | noisy | 0.066 ± 0.004 | 0.682 ± 0.014 | +0.026 ± 0.003 |
| FedProx μ=0.1 | clean (targets not applied) | 0.014 ± 0.002 | 0.882 ± 0.014 | -0.001 ± 0.001 |

excess = pred_noisy − (1 − pred_original)/8: agreement with the injected label beyond what wrong predictions would produce by chance if they were independent of the injected label. The clean rows are the zero line: the clean model never saw the injected labels.
